cost.comment: Every cost source is calibrated to task-level USD. Full-suite and source-specific costs remain raw evidence and are bridged through exact model overlaps.

algorithms.label: Robust affine (Theil-Sen)
algorithms.description: Median pairwise slope plus median intercept. Robust to outlying anchor models and the default production mapping. Cost is fitted in log10 space.

algorithms.label: Huber affine IRLS
algorithms.description: Weighted least squares with iterative Huber residual weights. More efficient than Theil-Sen when most anchors are clean, while limiting the leverage of outliers.

algorithms.label: Monotone piecewise linear
algorithms.description: Pools non-monotone anchor blocks with weighted isotonic regression, then linearly interpolates between anchor knots. Useful when benchmark scales compress or stretch nonlinearly.

identity_matching.comment: Do not silently match different effort levels. Add explicit manual anchors if a source label requires a justified crosswalk.

task_cost_estimator.comment: This is a fallback coordinate, not a measured bill. The raw estimate is input tokens × input price + output/reasoning-equivalent tokens × output price. Multipoint calibration then maps the proxy to AA cost per task. Direct task-cost evidence outranks it in the dashboard.

token_price_proxy.source_label: AA token count × blended token price proxy
token_price_proxy.comment: Uses model-specific AA evaluation token totals and the attached AA 7:2 blended token price. It is calibrated to task-level cost through exact overlaps with published AA cost-per-task records.
